segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: Blank check company formed to effect a business combination; intends to focus on social commerce (direct selling) targets.
segments.evidence: Social Commerce Partners Corporation (the "Company") is a blank check company incorporated on August 11, 2025 as a Cayman Islands exempted company and formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses, which we refer to throughout this report as our initial business combination.
